caption: The drawing features two views of a ring composed primarily of gold and red gemstones. The upper part of the drawing shows a top-down view of the ring: the band, rendered in yellow to represent gold, surrounds a central oval red gemstone encircled by several smaller round red stones, forming a floral or cluster pattern. The lower part of the drawing presents a side view of the same ring, displaying the gold band and the elevated setting that holds the gemstones, highlighting their dome-like arrangement above the finger. The background is a plain, off-white or light cream color, and the name "John. H. Tercuzzi." is inscribed in small capital letters in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Ring
